Docket 1.3.82

**Five more findings that were wrong about real sites, now fixed.**

Docket was run again across the same sample of 110 well-known websites, and
every serious finding was checked by hand against the pages. These are the
ones that did not hold up.

- *"Your Google Ads conversion cannot fire"* when the page had no Google Ads
  snippet at all — only a cookie-consent tool's list of cookies to delete,
  which names Google's ad domain. An ad platform's address now counts only
  when a script actually loads it.
- *"robots.txt blocks the entire site"* at the most serious level, when the
  file lets Google and Bing in by name and simply leaves a smaller search
  engine off its list. It is now reported at a severity that matches, and says
  plainly that Google is not affected.
- *A whole report built on a "we're busy, please wait" page.* Some sites
  answer with a waiting room when they are under load. Docket used to grade
  that page as the site; it now recognises it, sets it aside, and tells you to
  run the audit again later.
- *"No phone number anywhere on the site"* from a single page, on a site whose
  own sitemap lists thousands. Findings about something missing now say how
  many pages were checked unless Docket really did see the whole site.
- *"Pages are served without compression"* on servers that compress with
  Brotli, which is what browsers and Google ask for. Docket now asks the
  server whether it offers Brotli before saying anything.

99 checks across 13 areas.
